close_reason: Fixed: removed the bare {} scope — it was a no-op since the inner if block already scopes the variables. Code is now flat and readable.
description: submission.rs lines 353-398: the pre-fetch block for submission_email_id_map is wrapped in a bare { } scope with a comment explaining what the block does but not why it is a block at all. The scope exists to limit the borrow lifetime of args so the borrow checker does not flag later uses of args after the block. Without this explanation a contributor will either delete the scope (breaking compilation) or be confused by the unusual style. Add a one-line comment: '// Scoped to drop the borrow of args before args is used below.'
title: submission_email_id_map pre-fetch scope unexplained
